title: feat(app-shell): the help menu's About names the console build (objectui#12970)
body:
Fixes #12970
Clause-②: no

## What this does

The help menu gains 「关于」 / About on every console bar. The tenant console (`app` variant) and the control plane (`home` / `orgs` / `studio`) all draw the help menu from the same component, `AppHeader`, so the item is added once and appears on both planes. It opens a small dialog that names the build the console was compiled from:

- `VITE_APP_VERSION` from the build's environment, when it is set (cloud's Dockerfiles will pass it as a build-arg once this lands; that half is cloud's, ⛔ not changed here).
- Otherwise, the short sha of `HEAD` that `apps/console/vite.config.ts` reads from git at build time.
- With neither, the dialog says "Unknown build (no version was set when this console was built)" in words, from i18n. The field is never empty.

One reader, shared: `packages/app-shell/src/buildIdentity.ts` (`resolveConsoleBuild` / `getConsoleBuild`). The dialog reads it. Sentry's release fallback reads it through the new pure `resolveSentryRelease`: `VITE_SENTRY_RELEASE`, else the build identity, else `'unknown'`. There is no second spelling.

Text goes through five new keys, `help.about`, `help.aboutTitle`, `help.aboutDescription`, `help.aboutBuild` and `help.aboutBuildUnknown`, in all ten packs. No new runtime-config key.

**The runtime's build identity is not shown.** app-shell has no request that reads `/api/v1/health` today. Showing it would need a new request path, so the dispatch ruling says to skip it.

## A1: how the value reaches the bundle (measured)

- **Mechanism: Vite `define`, not env passthrough.** The console config computes `consoleBuild = process.env.VITE_APP_VERSION?.trim() || readGitShortSha()`. When the result is non-empty, the config bakes it as `define['import.meta.env.VITE_APP_VERSION']`. Vite 8.2.2 merges `import.meta.env.*` defines into the `import.meta.env` object it substitutes at build time (read in vite's `dist/node/chunks/node.js`, `userDefineEnv`).
- **The library build has no app commit.** `@object-ui/app-shell` builds with bare `tsc`, so its `dist/` still reads `import.meta.env.VITE_APP_VERSION`. The APP's Vite build substitutes the value. The library itself reads nothing at build time.
- **Measured chain.** The run resolves the console's own config with `vite.resolveConfig`, then bundles `buildIdentity.ts` with the resulting define and imports the output:
  - With `VITE_APP_VERSION=0707b4ae`: define `"0707b4ae"`, and the bundled `getConsoleBuild()` returns `"0707b4ae"`.
  - With it unset: define `"1c4bed6f91"` (= `git rev-parse --short HEAD`), and the bundled read returns `"1c4bed6f91"`.
- **Git read across checkout shapes.** On a `--depth 1` clone with a detached HEAD, `git rev-parse --short HEAD` answers (`shallow=true`, `branch=HEAD`). In a directory with no `.git`, it exits 128. The config catches that, bakes nothing, and the dialog states the fallback.

## Tests (at `1c4bed6f91`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.aboutBuild-12970.test.tsx` covers three cases:
  - (a) All four variants' help menus carry the About menuitem, read from the packs. On `app` and `home`, the dialog names a baked commit.
  - (b) With no identity, the dialog shows `help.aboutBuildUnknown`, never empty text.
- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/buildIdentity-12970.test.ts` covers the pure reader (trim; absent, empty or non-string gives null).
  - (c) `resolveSentryRelease` falls back to exactly what `resolveConsoleBuild` reads, and to `'unknown'` when the build named neither.
- **Run:** both new files gave 2 files / 19 tests passed. The related families also passed, 33 files / 372 tests: every `AppHeader.*` suite, `sentry.test.ts`, the product-neutral ratchet, and the i18n `dead-pack-keys-retired-8754`, `residue-namespaces-3546`, `all-locales-key-parity`, `en-zh-key-parity` and `machineLocaleCensus-9909` suites.
- **Ablation, done once with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:**
  - The anchor was the whole About `DropdownMenuItem`. It hit 1 time, went 1 to 0, and the blob changed `b1af036b0a0f` to `8f5f9e1872db`.
  - The new AppHeader suite went 8 of 8 failed.
  - The restore was proven by blob hash: `b1af036b0a0f` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Screenshot: not taken.** A full console build plus a backend did not fit this container's lock budget. The rendered-test reading above stands in for it.

## Gates (exit codes, at `1c4bed6f91`)

- Closure build `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2`: 28/28 tasks, exit 0.
- `type-check` exit 0 for `@object-ui/app-shell` and for `@object-ui/i18n`. `apps/console` `tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force` (it covers `vite.config.ts`) exit 0.
- ESLint, narrowed to the 17 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 17 files linted, 0 errors. All warnings are `no-explicit-any` / `no-unused-vars`, in pre-existing code or in mock-shape lines copied from the sibling AppHeader suites.
  - Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js` (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- Every gate in this battery exited 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, and objectstack's `check-nul-bytes`.
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell/`, `packages/i18n/` and `apps/console/` vitest directories (not run whole locally, per the dispatch), and `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- `apps/console/docs/error-tracking.md` still says `VITE_SENTRY_RELEASE` "Defaults to `VITE_APP_VERSION`, then `unknown`". That remains true, but the doc does not mention the new git-sha fallback. The doc is outside this claim's file surface, so it is left for a follow-up docs touch.
- The About state is component state, not a URL param (AGENTS.md #8: ephemeral, nobody shares a link to it).
